svg.title: The two halves of a script
svg.desc: A short script. Its first six lines, outside program(), run once in the editor when the script is applied; the trigger() call there becomes one trigger of the map, which plays on every version of the game. The program() below runs in the game, frame after frame, and needs StarCraft: Remastered. Inside it, price is the number 150 and reward(P1) is a Create Unit action, both worked out when the script is applied.
svg.text: The two halves of a script
↑ becomes one trigger of the map
← a Create Unit action, made when applied

g.text: Runs once, in the editor, when the script is applied.
Each trigger() call becomes a trigger of the map. Such
triggers play on every version of the game.
Runs in the game, frame after frame. It is built into
the map when it is saved, and needs StarCraft: Remastered.
What a program takes from outside its body (a constant, a
helper, a condition, an action) is worked out when the script
is applied, before the game starts.
